source='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = [[row[c] for c in range(w)] for row in grid]\n    for r in range(h - 1, 0, -1):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r - 1][c] != grid[0][0]:\n                out[r][c] = grid[r - 1][c]\n                out[r - 1][c] = grid[0][0]\n    return out\n'''
